overview_description.description: HeyDoc! is a healthcare technology platform dedicated to connecting patients with the right medical consultants, wherever they are, the easiest way possible. Delivering in-app consultations, without the need for physical appointments. Its objective is to produce a global digital healthcare platform that serves and facilitates all healthcare related needs of all individuals.
